eyebrow: Garage flooring · space for everyday life
title: Room for the good stuff.
body: The bikes. The workbench. The car you love. A garage can be useful and feel considered. For an Edmonton garage floor, start with the slab, then talk through cleaning, wet-weather use, texture, and the finish that belongs in your home.
detail: In these archive views, look at the open floor area and the detail where the finished surface meets the perimeter. A conversation about those edges is just as useful as choosing a colour.

eyebrow: Material choices · a finish that belongs
title: The details pull it together.
body: Warm neutrals or cool grey. A quiet background or a more expressive blend. Your floor should work with the room around it. These Final Finish archive views bring the material decision closer: tone, texture, and the way the finish meets the wall.
detail: Ask Denis about available samples, perimeter details, traction, and cleaning. The right choice depends on how the space will actually be used—not just how a swatch looks on screen.

eyebrow: Concrete preparation · look beneath the colour
title: Good preparation shows.
body: If your garage floor is dusty, marked, or carrying an old coating, choosing a new colour is only part of the job. The starting surface matters. These archive photographs show preparation equipment and a finished flake surface, presented as separate views.
detail: Share cracks, worn areas, existing coatings, and moisture concerns when you request a quote. Denis can assess what the concrete needs before recommending a floor coating for your Edmonton home or workspace.
